_doc: Fix 4 evidence: is any of the canonical ZIPs with no geo.zcta_boundary row a Census ZCTA that HomeSignal failed to load or publish? Every value here was read from production on 2026-10-01 by the queries in no-boundary-zips.sql. Census was read from Postgres through pg_net (the build sandbox has no egress to census.gov). scripts/fix4_classify_no_boundary_zips.py reads this file and refuses to run if the input export does not match the fingerprints below.

no_boundary_input.definition: public.canonical_zip_registry ZIPs with no geo.zcta_boundary row, joined to their level='zip' page in public.communities
no_boundary_input.fingerprint_rule: zip_md5 = md5 of the ZIPs joined by ',' in byte order; rows_md5 = md5 of the rows joined by '\n' in byte order with no trailing newline; both computed in the database with collate "C"

serving.note: The serving generation marks exactly the no-boundary ZIPs not_measured (same md5 as no_boundary_input.zip_md5). Part D D11 (applied by Part G 2026-09-29) refuses READY/ACTIVATE on any status that disagrees with geo.zcta_boundary.

census_zcta_2020_layers._doc: Current Census ZCTA delineation as served by TIGERweb, a different carrier from the TIGER/Line archive the boundary table was loaded from. TIGERweb returned byte-identical bodies for all four layers (response_md5), so they are ONE independent check served four ways, not four checks.
census_zcta_2020_layers.codes_md5_rule: md5 of the ZCTA5 codes joined by ',' with order by collate "C"

layers.name: 2020 Census ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (BAS 2026 group)
2020 Census ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (ACS 2025 group)
2020 Census ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (Census 2020 group)

census_zcta_2010._doc: The previous (2010) delineation. Context only: a 2010 polygon is a superseded delineation and is never a boundary for a current ZIP page.
census_zcta_2010.name: ZIP Code Tabulation Areas
